text:
Toronto is the story. The Maple Leafs are 0-5-0 in their last five, outscored 22-9, and fell 5-2 to Minnesota two nights ago, with Kirill Marchenko, Colton Sissons and Nick Blankenburg out. John Tavares has taken Marchenko's spot beside Paul and William Nylander, while Jack Roslovic is up to 19:34 a night from 16:11. Edmonton has won three straight, including a 3-2 overtime win over Philadelphia, though it's without Isaac Howard. The Oilers also lost 7-2 in Toronto on Oct 24.

The chances say this one is closer than the standings of the moment. Our model projects 3.14 expected goals (the quality of chances) for EDM and 2.82 for TOR. Toronto gives up 3.43 expected goals per 60 minutes, and Edmonton's power play, at 0.81 per game, meets a penalty kill allowing 0.78. The Leafs also take 4.2 penalties a game. In net, Anthony Stolarz (projected, starting over Sergei Bobrovsky) is at +0.5 goals saved above expected, while Devon Levi (projected) is at +1.5. Stolarz was at -6.58 last season.

Connor McDavid is at 42% to score and 93% for a point, with a 20-game point streak. Leon Draisaitl is our top goal pick at 49%. For Toronto, Auston Matthews is at 37%. Our under-the-radar pick is Colton Dach, a third-liner whose shots have been dangerous: 2.1 expected goals in his last 10 games, and we have him at 16% to score. Zach Hyman is one point from 500 career points, but that milestone isn't in our numbers.
